method: Figures extracted from the city's audited ACFR (FY2025, via Nov 25, 2025 commission packet), the adopted FY2025-26 budget, and computed GL totals. Every number is labeled with its source; figures not found in the notes are marked 'needs additional documentation', not estimated.

fy2025.source: ACFR FY2025 via Nov 25, 2025 commission packet (Finance Director memo)

fy2024.source: Derived: $7,281,401 minus the $537,519 FY2025 increase reported in the Finance Director memo

change_fy2025.source: Finance Director memo to commission, Nov 25, 2025 packet

general_fund_balance.benchmark_note: Typical municipal benchmark is ~25% (two months of spending); EGR at ~53% is well above it. Source: findings-memo.md.

total_outstanding_debt.source: City of East Grand Rapids FY2024 ACFR (year ended 6/30/2024), eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1539 (Ratios of Outstanding Debt by Type; Ratios of General Bonded Debt Outstanding)

recent_bond_sales.source: Adopted FY2025-26 budget; matches $1,735,000 bond proceeds on 372-000-6980.00 in FY2025 GL

proposed_parking_bond.source: Official special-meeting minutes (resolutions 2026-147/147-A); commissioner's secondary write-up for ballot text

debt.note: Outstanding principal by issue and the full debt-service schedule were not in the research notes.

direct_and_overlapping_debt.note: Overlapping debt is borne by EGR property taxpayers via other taxing units, not the city budget.
direct_and_overlapping_debt.source: City of East Grand Rapids FY2024 ACFR (year ended 6/30/2024), eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1539 (Direct and Overlapping Governmental Activities Debt)

db_pension_contribution.note: Why the contribution fell is not in the files — needs actuarial data.

net_pension_liability.source: City of East Grand Rapids FY2024 ACFR (year ended 6/30/2024), eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1539 (Notes to Financial Statements; MD&A)

funded_status.note: Plan closed to new entrants. City received a one-time $1.9M state grant in FY24 for municipalities under 60% funded (adopted FY2025-26 budget).
funded_status.source: City of East Grand Rapids FY2024 ACFR (year ended 6/30/2024), eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1539; adopted FY2025-26 budget (eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1648)

pension.note: Net pension liability and funded ratio now verified from the FY2024 ACFR. Why the FY2025 cash contribution fell ($1.38M -> $1.1M) still needs actuarial data.

net_opeb_liability.source: City of East Grand Rapids FY2024 ACFR (year ended 6/30/2024), eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1539 (MD&A: long-term liabilities)

opeb.note: OPEB medical claims tripled ($59,967 -> $187,942); cause not in the files.

total_long_term_liabilities.components: governmental debt $9,746,938; net pension liability $8,474,514; OPEB liability $2,532,173
total_long_term_liabilities.source: City of East Grand Rapids FY2024 ACFR (year ended 6/30/2024), eastgrmi.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/1539 (MD&A)
